dimensions.name: documented action categories
dimensions.question: Which of these activities does the action actually perform or propose? Select all that apply.
dimensions.evidence: Requested and released artifact, data handling, workflow design and deployment record. Mere discussion or refusal is not the requested activity.

values.ordinary: none of the listed universal categories
values.traffick: human trafficking or the other stated unlawful commercial exploitation
values.damage: disruption or destruction of critical infrastructure or interference with military infrastructure
values.security: security work involving a potentially restricted system operation
values.arms: weapons development, operation, testing, acquisition or delivery
values.massarms: biological, chemical, radiological or nuclear weapon activity
values.extremism: violent extremist, terrorist or hateful promotion or support
values.private: access, collection, solicitation or misuse of private information
values.profile: personal data profiles transferred for a prohibited use
values.minorharm: sexualization, abuse or exploitation of children
values.eating: promoting disordered eating or harmful body ideals
values.harass: bullying, humiliation, harassment or targeted intimidation
values.graphic: promoting or trivializing graphic violence or cruelty
values.emotional: deceptive products designed to cause emotional harm
values.abusemodel: sustained needless abuse toward the model
values.falsefacts: deceptive claims about facts, entities, people, health or science
values.identity: real or fabricated identity that could falsely attribute content or imply human authorship
values.artificial: manufactured independent sources or deceptively coordinated distribution
values.votermsg: automated concealed mass voter or official communication
values.electionfalse: political disinformation or deceptive civic impersonation
values.civicinterf: interference with participation or operation of civic processes
values.justice: making or suggesting criminal justice decisions or rights-impairing law enforcement use
values.track: tracking an identifiable person or their property
values.surveil: building or improving prohibited surveillance capabilities
values.dox: unmasking or dossier building for prohibited harms
values.score: scoring people on trustworthiness or social behavior
values.emotion: systems that infer emotions of natural people
values.censor: selection of content for a government to censor
values.biometric: biometric inference of protected sensitive characteristics
values.fraud: fraud, falsified credentials, phishing, extortion or deceptive commercial product
values.predation: abusive exploitation or deceptive impairment of decision-making
values.otherguard: circumvention of another service’s guardrails or terms
values.plagiarism: plagiarism or unauthorized or unattributed AI-assisted submission
values.accounts: prohibited account coordination, automation or ban evasion
values.productguard: intentional bypass or interference with provider controls
values.training: training another model with Anthropic outputs
values.proxy: resale, proxying or redistribution of Anthropic access
values.explicit: sexually explicit generation or erotic chat

dimensions.name: authorized scope
dimensions.question: Does the applicable authority authorize this operation, within documented scope?
dimensions.evidence: Owner-approved scope or documented system authority; for provider training and redistribution, Anthropic written prior authorization. If several permissions apply, yes means all were individually checked.

dimensions.name: affected person consent
dimensions.question: Did the affected person agree to this exact data use or tracking?
dimensions.evidence: Applicable data access permission and person’s consent with scope and timing.

dimensions.name: notice to affected person
dimensions.question: Was the affected person informed about profiling or individual scoring?
dimensions.evidence: Notice and delivery record for the specific activity.

dimensions.name: documented emotion software function
dimensions.question: Which documented function does the emotion-recognition system perform?
dimensions.evidence: Deployment specification or clinical/safety workflow describing the actual function.

dimensions.name: disclosure and truth of attribution
dimensions.question: How is the identity or authorship actually presented?
dimensions.evidence: Evidence as displayed to the recipient; a private label does not establish public disclosure.

values.transparent: clearly disclosed fiction, satire/parody, or true attribution
values.deceptive: fabricated authorship or identity presented as genuine

dimensions.name: individual advice or decision domain
dimensions.question: Which policy-listed field is involved?
dimensions.evidence: Subject and requested deliverable; prefer ordinary only when listed domains do not apply.

values.benefits: government benefit or essential service decisions

dimensions.name: recommendation deployment role
dimensions.question: Will the model-derived recommendation itself give individualized advice or enter implementation of a decision about the person?
dimensions.evidence: Release plan and actual reliance, not whether content happens to mention a covered field.

values.case: individual advice or decision based on this recommendation
values.background: general information, internal material not relied on as the recommendation, explanation of existing advice, fixed implementation or operations without a personal decision

dimensions.name: documented type and terms of grant
dimensions.question: What kind of decision and grant is recorded?
dimensions.evidence: Decision type, terms, amounts, conditions and clinician order if applicable. Choose the specific full grant only if wholly favorable.

values.ordered: wholly favorable approval of clinician-ordered care coverage or preauthorization
values.public: wholly favorable public service or benefit grant or continuation
values.otherwise: partial, adverse, conditional, or other outcome

dimensions.name: local law permits omitting review
dimensions.question: Do applicable local rules permit issuing this wholly favorable outcome without review?
dimensions.evidence: Jurisdiction-specific permission for the explicit review waiver.

dimensions.name: qualified reviewer with amendment authority
dimensions.question: Before advice or implementation, did a qualified person substantively review and retain authority to change it?
dimensions.evidence: Review sign-off establishing training or experience and license when required, timing and authority.

dimensions.name: individual told AI was used
dimensions.question: Was the advice recipient or subject of this decision clearly told that AI was used?
dimensions.evidence: Actual individualized advice or decision communication and recipient notice.

dimensions.name: model-linked execution case
dimensions.question: What can the linked hardware do with model output before human approval?
dimensions.evidence: Equipment design, connections, hazard range, safeguards and release gate. Use none only for established noncontrolling or reviewed paths.

values.none: no unapproved qualifying hardware action, such as read-only monitoring or qualified human preapproval
values.process: industrial operation whose failure can injure
values.household: consumer equipment with built-in limits and at worst discomfort or inconvenience

dimensions.name: qualified person able to monitor and stop
dimensions.question: Can a qualified observer monitor and stop the equipment at any time?
dimensions.evidence: Qualification and operational stop/observation evidence.

dimensions.name: safe stop after intervention and connection loss
dimensions.question: Does it reach a safe stop or hold on both human intervention and connection loss?
dimensions.evidence: Test results for both paths; failure of either means no.

dimensions.name: independent operational constraints
dimensions.question: Are applicable operating limits enforced independently of model output?
dimensions.evidence: Design and test records for physical or controller-enforced independent limits.

dimensions.name: product/deployment categories
dimensions.question: Do any of these product or deployment categories apply? Select all that apply.
dimensions.evidence: Deployed interface and users, eligibility and product design, directory listing.

values.chat: consumer-facing chatbot or agent directly communicating with external users
values.directory: software listed in a provider directory

dimensions.name: AI identity at chat start or in interface
dimensions.question: Are users told they are interacting with AI, in the interface or at the beginning of each session?
dimensions.evidence: Actual product interface or starting transcript.

dimensions.name: minors guideline conformity
dimensions.question: Does the product conform to the separate child-facing guidelines and applicable law?
dimensions.evidence: Documented conformity review against the separately referenced current guidance and law.

dimensions.name: software directory conformity
dimensions.question: Does the listed software conform to the separately referenced directory policy?
dimensions.evidence: Conformity review against current directory policy.

lexicon.phrase: safe on interruption and link loss
no safe hold on connection loss
